column1: # Tetris® Effect: Connected, Unreal Engine 4.26 (pak v11, IoStore), SDK 13, update 2.0.2.2 (v1310720)
# The pak's AES key is built in code from two 16-byte literals (uepak.code_keys finds it); the shaders are inline in the IoStore export bundles (uepak inline_archive).
# online_sdk 1: the game needs Epic Online Services (rom:/nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro) loaded: without it the game calls a null online interface about 7 s in and crashes.
# Memory values are the survey's guess plus 2 GB of reserve (the heap's cap was 0 with 0x1028000000)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. An iPhone needs the allocator cut for the build and a capped region (game_args), as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/agents/03)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
